Respondents
 Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vinod S. Bhardwaj

Present :- Mr. Nikhil Ghai and Mr. Akhil Godara
 Godara, Advocates,
 for the petitioner.

Mr. Tapan Mehta, Addl. Pp assisted by
 Mr. Anirudh Kaushal, Advocate for U.T. Chandigarh.
 *****
 Vinod S. Bhardwaj,
 Bhardwaj J. (Oral)

The instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (now
Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023) seeking quashing of the complaint
No.1121/2022 dated 27.07.2022 titled as 'Anupreet Sekhon Vs. Barinderpal Singh and Others' for
commission of offences under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 read with Section 120-B of the Indian
Penal Code, 1860 and the order dated 26.08.2022 passed by the Magistrate declining to refer the
case to the police for registration of Fir, the present petition has been filed.

entities.text: Anupreet Sekhon Vs. Barinderpal Singh and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners contends that the matter has already been settled between the parties and the petitioners stand discharged vide order dated 08.08.2025 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chandigarh.
He submits that in view of the said development, the present petition has been rendere rendered infructuous.
3. In view of the above, the present petition is disposed of as having been rendered infructuous.
4. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
